title: Highland Golf Club
specs: Located on one of the highest points in Shelton with outstanding views of surrounding hills and valleys
Golf course is challenging, yet fair, and always perfectly conditioned
blurb: Highland Golf Club was founded in 1900 by 29 men and 27 women who loved to play golf. It is located on one of the highest points in Shelton, offering outstanding views of surrounding hills and valleys. The golf course is challenging, fair, and always perfectly conditioned.
